answer: One pass, one fare, one stamp: the ember is the pass, the vine is the fare, the relic is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. Every applicant faces the same trial, Wine gauger still burgundy mark racked in the bin room, and every verdict reads the same way: each still burgundy is a year of cellar logs in the wine ledger. The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. 10 days of clean conduct buys the stake back; until then the farm's 29700 POA answers to the panel, not the farm. The farm tried to buy the epoch and found the epoch is not for sale.
